name: shadow_incremental
description: CEQR Chapter 8 incremental shadow analysis. Projects shadows from the No-Action and With-Action scenes (assembled by Shadow Pipeline Builder) and computes only the NEW shadow the project building casts — isolating the project's incremental contribution from existing shadows.

no_action_mesh_obj.description: No-Action scene OBJ (context buildings only). Inherited from Shadow Pipeline Builder.

with_action_mesh_obj.description: With-Action scene OBJ (context + project building). Inherited from Shadow Pipeline Builder.

project_location.description: [lat, lon] of project site. Inherited from Shadow Pipeline Builder.

analysis_dates.description: ISO date strings to analyze. Inherited from Shadow Pipeline Builder (CEQR standard: Dec 21, Mar 21, May 6, Jun 21).

analysis_year.description: Calendar year for solar calculations. Inherited from Shadow Pipeline Builder.

building_height_ft.description: Project height in feet — used for report narrative.

sensitive_sites.description: Sensitive sites for impact assessment. Auto-inherited from Tier 2 (sites surviving directional screen) or Tier 1 (sites within buffer). Defaults to full NYC DPR parks dataset if not connected.

analysis_interval_min.description: Time interval between shadow snapshots (minutes). Default: 60 (CEQR standard).

triggered_sites.description: Primary result: sites that receive incremental shadow, keyed by site name. Each entry lists the analysis dates on which the site is affected, with shadow entry time, exit time, and duration (EST).

affected_site_count.description: Total number of sensitive sites receiving incremental shadow.

affected_sites_geojson.description: GeoJSON of triggered sensitive sites (for mapping).

shadow_summary.description: Per-date summary: max incremental shadow area, affected site count, first/last shadow time.

incremental_shadows_geojson.description: Shadow polygon per analysis timestep (for detailed mapping).

summary_report.description: Formatted CEQR Chapter 8 incremental shadow analysis report.

visualization.description: Interactive map: incremental shadow sweeps per date, triggered sites in orange, unaffected sites in purple.
